titulo_original: The Tropic Sun and His Eyes

sinopsis.es: Ruben regresa a Haití a pie para reconectarse con su padre distanciado. Cuando un niño callejero persistente negocia acompañarlo, los dos navegan Cap-Haïtien en un debut melancólico y silenciosamente luminoso.
sinopsis.en: Ruben returns to Haiti on foot to reconnect with his estranged father. When a persistent street kid makes a deal with him, the two navigate Cap-Haïtien in a debut that is both melancholic and quietly luminous.
